features.title: The shell opens, shows its content and renders after real input
features.acceptance: After the main window is shown and driven with pointer, wheel, text and key input, every kind of input has reached the application, its content is still in the visual tree, and a frame is rendered at the window's client size.

features.title: Resizing the shell re-lays-out and re-renders its content
features.acceptance: After the main window is resized twice with input in between, its content is laid out to the new client size each time and the next rendered frame has that size.

features.title: Keyboard traversal of the shell finds no focusable controls yet
features.acceptance: After a click, three Tabs, a Shift-Tab, a command chord and typed text, nothing in the shell holds focus and every key reached the window in the order it was pressed.

features.title: A pointer session is delivered to the shell in order
features.acceptance: A hover, a drag along a four-point path, a double click, a wheel turn and a key press arrive at the window in order, with the left button held on every drag move and a click count of two on the second press.
